panels.title: Consultations — status & summary (click Consultation ID to open flow)

targets.expr: {app="hospital-service",namespace="prod"} |= "Consultation booked" | regexp "with ID: (?P<consultationId>[0-9a-f-]{36})" | consultationId =~ ".+" | label_format status="REQUESTED", summary="Consultation booked - payment confirmed" | line_format "{\"consultationId\":\"{{.consultationId}}\",\"status\":\"{{.status}}\",\"summary\":\"{{.summary}}\"}"}

{namespace="prod"} |= "[batch] START" | regexp "consultationId=(?P<consultationId>[0-9a-f-]{36})" | consultationId =~ ".+" | label_format status="SEARCHING", summary="Doctor search started" | line_format "{\"consultationId\":\"{{.consultationId}}\",\"status\":\"{{.status}}\",\"summary\":\"{{.summary}}\"}"}

{namespace="prod"} |= "consultation:matched" | regexp "consultationId=(?P<consultationId>[0-9a-f-]{36})" | consultationId =~ ".+" | label_format status="MATCHED", summary="Doctor accepted - matched to patient" | line_format "{\"consultationId\":\"{{.consultationId}}\",\"status\":\"{{.status}}\",\"summary\":\"{{.summary}}\"}"}

{app="websocket-gateway",namespace="prod"} |= "[delivery] DONE" | regexp "consultationId=(?P<consultationId>[0-9a-f-]{36})" | consultationId =~ ".+" | label_format status="IN_CALL", summary="Video tokens delivered - call ready" | line_format "{\"consultationId\":\"{{.consultationId}}\",\"status\":\"{{.status}}\",\"summary\":\"{{.summary}}\"}"}

{namespace="prod"} |= "consultation:no_doctors" | regexp "consultationId=(?P<consultationId>[0-9a-f-]{36})" | consultationId =~ ".+" | label_format status="NO_DOCTORS", summary="No doctor accepted - search exhausted" | line_format "{\"consultationId\":\"{{.consultationId}}\",\"status\":\"{{.status}}\",\"summary\":\"{{.summary}}\"}"}

{app="websocket-gateway",namespace="prod"} |= "COMPLETE_DONE" | regexp "consultationId=(?P<consultationId>[0-9a-f-]{36})" | consultationId =~ ".+" | label_format status="COMPLETED", summary="Consultation completed by doctor" | line_format "{\"consultationId\":\"{{.consultationId}}\",\"status\":\"{{.status}}\",\"summary\":\"{{.summary}}\"}"}

{namespace="prod"} |= "patient_cancelled" | regexp "consultationId=(?P<consultationId>[0-9a-f-]{36})" | consultationId =~ ".+" | label_format status="CANCELLED", summary="Patient cancelled the search" | line_format "{\"consultationId\":\"{{.consultationId}}\",\"status\":\"{{.status}}\",\"summary\":\"{{.summary}}\"}"}
